title: MintFlow：面向约束流匹配的最小轨迹干预方法
summary: MintFlow 是一种无需训练的约束采样框架，将约束执行建模为对预训练流轨迹的最小干预。通过伴随公式得到闭式扰动解，避免迭代优化，并自适应选择干预时机，在满足约束的同时更好地保持预训练生成分布。
summary_en: MintFlow is a training-free constrained sampling framework that formulates constraint enforcement as a minimal intervention on the pretrained flow trajectory. An adjoint formulation yields a closed-form perturbation, eliminating iterative optimization, and adaptive intervention timing balances perturbation magnitude against flow amplification. It achieves competitive constraint satisfaction while better preserving the pretrained generative distribution than state-of-the-art methods.
